starling_edm__008.caption_guidance: Describe a bright synthesized lead or pluck over an electronic beat, electronic drums, bass and pads, with audible sectional development. Do not assert pipa, guzheng, acoustic strings or orchestral backing.
starling_edm__008.rationale: The final MOSS audit scored the cautious caption at the minimum acceptable threshold but still identified string and orchestral wording as unsupported. This entry forces one more caption repair only; it cannot bypass the listening gate because the second blind Qwen view did not complete.

thefatrat__020.caption_guidance: Describe an East-Asian-influenced melodic electronic/trap hybrid. Use a plucked acoustic-electronic lead or guqin-like plucked timbre layered with synth tones, an electronic beat, synth bass, and changing atmospheric sections. Do not describe a pure orchestral recording or a pure synth-only EDM arrangement.
thefatrat__020.rationale: The artist describes guqin/acoustic samples stacked with electronic sounds over an electronic beat for Pride & Fear; the official SoundCloud classifies the release as Trap, and identity-blind Qwen full plus chronological montage both classify the supplied waveform as Chinese-influenced melodic EDM with electronic production. MOSS reversed its verdict when the proposed caption changed, so its caption-conditioned rejection is retained as raw evidence but is not the sole gate authority for this record.
